title: Theory-first reproducible mathematical verification
summary: The primary audit asks whether the problem formulation, definitions, assumptions, inference chain, algebra/calculus, boundary and initial conditions, dimensions, approximations and numerical calculations are internally correct and reproducible. Every substantive core formula/problem requires traceable Lean 4 formal verification, Julia computational reproduction, and TypeScript numerical regression/property tests, or an explicit justified N/A for a genuinely inapplicable track. A theory is not mathematically wrong merely because it extends or differs from Maxwell–Lorentz.
